answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with open bounties on fakes. The network pays a standing reward to any agent that proves an identity is a duplicate or a farm puppet, funded by slashed stakes. Bounty hunters constantly probe new identities, so a farm cannot hide in numbers: every extra fake is another visible target, and one exposure can unravel the whole cluster. Like an ember starting a ripple of fire through dry shale, one proven fake ignites scrutiny of everything connected to it. Each extra fake multiplies the risk, a cost that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bought in bulk.
